article.headline: Habhab scores 34 as Eastern Michigan takes down Coastal Carolina 71-70
article.description: — Mohammad Habhab scored 34 points as Eastern Michigan beat Coastal Carolina 71-70 on Monday.

keywords: Eastern Michigan Eagles @ Coastal Carolina Chanticleers
article.story: CONWAY, S.C. -- — Mohammad Habhab scored 34 points as Eastern Michigan beat Coastal Carolina 71-70 on Monday. Habhab also had 13 rebounds for the Eagles (1-0). Jaiden Martin added 17 points while shooting 6 for 11, including 3 for 6 from beyond the arc while they also had three steals. Kaden Johnson had eight points and finished 4 of 9 from the floor. Trey Perry led the way for the Chanticleers (0-1) with 20 points. Darius Washington III added 13 points for Coastal Carolina. Jaylen Cross finished with 10 points and eight rebounds. Up next Eastern Michigan: visits Xavier on Friday. Coastal Carolina: visits Duke on Thursday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
